_readme: The ZCode model-response main-reply predicate, pinned on BOTH sides of the language boundary. A `session.updated` payload that states a finished generation carries `content` beside `stopReason`; only the RUNNING TURN's reply may reach the transcript and the context meter. Every other source is a side query: the app-server runs it for itself, and persisting it puts raw verifier JSON and summary titles into the chat. `TestZCodeModelResponseConformance` in the worker replays these cases against `zcodeIsMainReply`, and the browser's `modelResponseConformance.test.ts` replays them against `zcodeIsMainReply` in the provider plugin. The source words come from contracts/zcode-protocol.json. A payload with no `querySource` states its role through `stopReason`: `tool_internal` marks a side query, and any other stop reason is the turn reply. A `querySource` that is not the JSON string `main_turn` is never the reply, whatever its JSON type.

cases.name: the main turn is the reply
a subagent query is not the reply
a compaction query is not the reply
a goal summary title query is not the reply
a target completion verification query is not the reply
a git commit message query is not the reply
a workspace generate text query is not the reply
an unknown source is not the reply
an absent source with a turn stop reason is the reply
an absent source with the tool-internal stop reason is not the reply
an empty source string is not the reply
a non-string source is not the reply
a null source is present and not the reply beside a turn stop reason
